recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not reintroduce the old inv-1 XPath or requester backbone; any future onBehalfOf change should come through a new work-group decision that supersedes FHIR-13445 and FHIR-15128.
issue_request: FHIR-12519 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core _Request. It reported that Request.requester inv-1 used an invalid XPath contains() expression involving agent/onBehalfOf and recorded the approved correction as an agent.resolve()-based invariant expression.
initial_application: Jira recorded svn @11105; git history maps that to 5c1a24e73bdb67c0666527e5e9788c1b19b5ef9f, which updated Request.requestor/requester inv-1 to use agent.resolve(). A later unkeyed schematron cleanup, 759f5178356c92faad909caa6ed46aa17b92b10e, corrected the XPath from contains(f:agent, ...) to contains(f:agent/f:reference/@value, ...).
additional_context: Request is still an active logical model in source/fhir.ini, but later workflow-pattern changes removed Request.requester.agent and Request.requester.onBehalfOf. Commit 14b69a1c6dd33918b20d53ffd6cfbab523f840ba removed the obsolete inv-1 row. FHIR-13445 resolved no-change because the invariant was no longer relevant after dropping onBehalfOf, and FHIR-15128 later confirmed core should not restore workflow onBehalfOf; FHIR-15128 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml defines Request.requester as a direct Reference including PractitionerRole and Device and has no inv-1 expression, XPath, Request.requester.agent, or Request.requester.onBehalfOf entry to correct.
